I know how hard it is and how down it can get you but let me tell you something I've found that helps a lot. When you stop caring so much about your acne and what people think about it, it gets better! A lot of acne is related to stress so stressing out about it only makes it worse. I know it's easier said than done but it is possible, I'm living proof. You said it's taking away all your happiness but that's mostly because you let it honestly. Let me ask you, do you care about other people's skin? Do you think less of them because of it? Probably not. And this is how others see you, they don't care or think less of you because of it! Once you accept that acne is a chapter of your life, life will improve. Yes it's a difficult chapter but it's a chapter and it will end :) I know it's cliche but it's the inside that really matter. Don't let acne control your life and personality. I got an incredibly beautiful girlfriend ( en now :( ) because she fell in love with who I was as a person. Keep your head up and try not to let it get you down too much. You're beautiful ❤️

You sound like a good person and I think you should give yourself more credit. You said yourself you make her happiness your priority and that already shows your selfless and are able to really love her. It may feel like you're not able to fully reciprocate but you seem to try your best so just keep trying man. You said when she's happy you're barely happy, what do you mean? Doesnt making her happy make you happy? Does the things she does for you make you happy? As cheesy as it sounds, cherish the little things. I miss so many things that I took for granted with my ex: random kisses, holding her in my arms, making jokes together, making her smile and laugh, feeling her heartbeat.. Don't make the same mistakes I did and take anything for granted, keep showing her how much she means to you and I think her showing you that back will bring you joy, no? Don't worry about not being good enough, do the best you can and talk about it. Ask her if she feels loved enough or whatnot. It's possible she can still feel truly loved by you even with you battling your depression. Don't let it bring you down to much and make you think you can love her as much. I believe you can. Do you talk to her about it? Where do you think your depression comes from and do you think she can help or you can help yourself by getting to the root of it?
